      "login": "vasild",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "supports inclusion in 32.0 and 31.x; previously raised correctness, interface, and underflow concerns"
    },
    {
      "login": "mzumsande",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "Concept ACK, but raised concerns about memory retention, dead retry code, and Remove slot handling"
    },
    {
      "login": "instagibbs",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "note": "asked about backport intentions and noted release timing considerations"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "rc:4048119262",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "a transaction is marked as received when it has not actually been received",
      "quote": "Why replace Remove() with MarkReceived() here? The transaction has not been actually received.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "addressed by author rename to MarkResolved and confirmed by ACK",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4053474530",
        "rc:4057945725"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "r:5263963620",
      "status_by_quote": "ACK dad979bf010adeed16d9eebe9fb822f5c519b90c"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4048983149",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "the send_limit counter is incremented for a stale transaction even if it still has unused allowance",
      "quote": "This increments the send_limit counter for a transaction that came from GetStale() and is acceptable in the mempool. However such a transaction might still have unused \"allowance\".",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author added check before granting retry connection, confirmed by ACK",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4057960788"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "r:5263963620",
      "status_by_quote": "ACK dad979bf010adeed16d9eebe9fb822f5c519b90c"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4056094041",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "NumToOpenAdd call is redundant when stale retry logic already runs frequently enough to pick up failed sends",
      "quote": "we do not need the NumToOpenAdd(1) call here at all.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author explained why NumToOpenAdd is necessary and reviewer approved",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4057435531"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "r:5263963620",
      "status_by_quote": "ACK dad979bf010adeed16d9eebe9fb822f5c519b90c"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4061032714",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "a resolved transaction cannot be resent or scheduled again even though it is no longer queued or actively broadcast",
      "quote": "This is a weird situation for the user: Trying to resend a transaction is refused with \"Ignoring unnecessary request to schedule an already scheduled transaction\"",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author reverted to clearing resolved entries on Add and vasild approved",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4078549162"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "r:5291953863",
      "status_by_quote": "ACK e2a6665e8719ecc5ccd9ed03d3880c5543a15797"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4065921818",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "retry logic becomes effectively dead code because reaching 1000 resend attempts takes impractically long",
      "quote": "Now the retry is basically dead code, since it will take a long time until 1000 resend attempts are reached - I think it might as well be removed.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4066000330",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "transactions are kept in memory indefinitely until node restart or maximum limit, increasing resource usage",
      "quote": "This would lead to a potential unexpected increase in resource usage - before, we'd only keep transactions while they were in flight, and the shared pointer would be released",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author reverted to clearing entries at start of Add as requested; awaiting mzumsande confirmation",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4067384104",
        "rc:4078567433",
        "c:5788112713"
      ],
      "other_replies": [
        "rc:4071680127"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:5788112713",
      "status_by_quote": "Reverted the change to keep resolved txs until max size or node shutdown"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4066104589",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "a peer disconnecting without answering pong could cause Remove() to steal connection retry slots from unrelated transactions",
      "quote": "now a peer that completed the handshake (`fDisconnect=true`) but doesn't answer the pong would not get a `peer_ack`, but also wouldn't get a try back, so if we then call `Remove()` it could steal slot",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author updated Remove accounting to return difference between planned and current sends; awaiting mzumsande confirmation",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4078568608",
        "c:5788112713"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4078568608",
      "status_by_quote": "I've changed Remove to only return retry tokens for `std::max(0, 3 - current_sends)`"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4083240831",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "potential integer underflow if code is changed in the future",
      "quote": "It is correct now. But because we do not know how this code will be changed in the future, it would be more robust to guard against an underflow here",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    }
  ],
  "support": [

      "verdict": "Concept ACK",

      "substantive": false,
      "evidence": "none",

    },
    {

      "id": "r:5291953863",

      "areas": []
    }
  ],
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "author",
      "what": "author response to vasild's underflow suggestion and mzumsande's dead retry code concern",
      "id": "rc:4083240831"
    },
    {
      "on": "reviewer",
      "what": "mzumsande to re-review after author addressed memory and retry slot accounting concerns",
      "id": "c:5788112713"
    }
  ],
  "notes": "vasild commented in favor of including this in 32.0 and backporting to 31.x; no new claims or ACKs were added."
}
